how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-westfall-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9:obj:0: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
rows.quest:9:details:0: Look at what has happened to this place! These lands were once occupied by good farm folk. But the damned thieves have driven them all off. Not me, though! But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.
rows.quest:9:details:1: BIf you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them. Come back when you're done for your pay. If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
rows.quest:9:completion:0: Good work, friend. You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps ⟦E1⟧ will prosper once again.
rows.quest:12:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:12:details:0: The People's Militia has but one goal: To defend the lands of ⟦E1⟧ and return peace to our surroundings. Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood.
rows.quest:12:details:1: BOne of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby. I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
rows.quest:12:completion:0: Well done, ⟦1⟧. My scout witnessed your valiant acts. You are proving yourself quite well so far.
rows.quest:13:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:13:details:0: A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead. The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior. Dispatch immediately, ⟦2⟧, and make the Light's presence known in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:13:details:1: BThe Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower. As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
rows.quest:13:completion:0: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
rows.quest:14:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:14:details:0: Some Defias have eluded us. My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern ⟦E1⟧. We believe they are hiding out in the ⟦E2⟧ Hills, plotting their next move. Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
rows.quest:14:completion:0: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. But there is hope for ⟦E1⟧ yet. As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia. May the Light shine upon you.
rows.quest:22:obj:0: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.
rows.quest:22:details:0: The onions are peeled. The garlic is minced. The rosemary is crushed. The crust has been baked. The dill weed is chopped. The gravy is simmering. Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
rows.quest:22:completion:0: These are just perfect, ⟦3⟧! Thank you so much. Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. You didn't think I was going to let a ⟦4⟧ like you go hungry, did you?
rows.quest:36:obj:0: Verna Furlbrow wants you to deliver her recipe for ⟦E1⟧ Stew to Salma Saldean.
rows.quest:36:details:0: I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm. But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now. As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way. ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧Maybe you could do me a favor? Let me scribble down my recipe for ⟦E1⟧ stew. Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder. The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
rows.quest:36:completion:0: That Verna was always such a sweet lass. We'll miss her here in ⟦E1⟧ but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and ⟦E3⟧ will suit her just fine. But enough gossip! Now we can make ⟦E1⟧ Stew!
rows.quest:38:obj:0: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
rows.quest:38:details:0: Help me make some ⟦E1⟧ Stew! Come back with the following ingredients: ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ 3 Stringy Vulture Meat ⟦9⟧ 3 Goretusk Snouts ⟦10⟧ 3 Murloc Eyes ⟦11⟧ 3 Okra
rows.quest:38:completion:0: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely! Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts. And we're done! For all your help, ⟦12⟧, I want you to take today's first batch of ⟦E1⟧ Stew!
rows.quest:48:obj:0: Bring Holy Spring Water to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
rows.quest:48:details:0: In the land to the south where vines twist and creep⟦13⟧Lies a hidden well where the water runs deep⟦14⟧Pure as the Light's sacred Daughter⟦15⟧Bring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
rows.quest:49:obj:0: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants a Sack of Barley, a Sack of Rye and a Sack of Corn.
rows.quest:49:details:0: Amber is the hue of my life's longest love⟦16⟧Like the last embers of dusk in the sky above⟦17⟧Retrieve for me so that my love shall be born⟦18⟧One sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
rows.quest:50:details:0: I'll mix and mix till we have a mash⟦19⟧For this will be our own private stash⟦20⟧A still must be fashioned of metal strong⟦21⟧Bring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.
rows.quest:51:obj:0: Bring a Sycamore Branch to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
rows.quest:51:details:0: Not yet filtered but freshly distilled⟦22⟧Like unseeded land waiting there tilled.⟦23⟧Next I will fashion our pile of charcoal⟦24⟧Deliver a sycamore branch, that is your next goal.
rows.quest:53:obj:0: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak.
rows.quest:53:details:0: Mellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears⟦25⟧Turns a lovely deep amber over the years⟦26⟧But before we proceed to get lit to the hilt⟦27⟧A barrel of charred oak must be built.
rows.quest:53:completion:0: Aged in the barrel, filtered through coal⟦28⟧It passes your lips and right through your soul.⟦29⟧So lets us drink now, a toast to you⟦30⟧And me while we're at it, Grimbooze Thunderbrew!
rows.quest:64:obj:0: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
rows.quest:64:details:0: It was horrible! Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields. The fields were full of hooligans. We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch. Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it. I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse. Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it. If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
rows.quest:64:completion:0: My watch! Thank you so much, kind sir!
rows.quest:64:completion:1: BWe are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
rows.quest:65:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to talk to Wiley in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:65:details:0: The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of ⟦E1⟧ from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood. I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs. We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out. In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.
rows.quest:65:details:1: BTravel to Lakeshire in the ⟦E4⟧, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
rows.quest:65:completion:0: So, Stoutmantle sent you? Well, I owe him.
rows.quest:102:obj:0: Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:102:details:0: ⟦E3⟧ has abandoned us. A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of ⟦E1⟧. This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here. We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.
rows.quest:102:details:1: BYour task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of ⟦E1⟧. Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
rows.quest:102:completion:0: Well done, ⟦31⟧. With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, ⟦E1⟧ just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was. Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
rows.quest:103:obj:0: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E1⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:103:details:0: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack. But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.
rows.quest:103:details:1: BHelp me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
rows.quest:103:completion:0: Praise you, brave ⟦32⟧. The rocks of the ⟦E1⟧ Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.
rows.quest:103:completion:1: BI died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
rows.quest:104:obj:0: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E1⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:104:details:0: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me. The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off. They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again. The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.
rows.quest:104:details:1: BSlay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
rows.quest:104:completion:0: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, ⟦33⟧. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
rows.quest:132:obj:0: Take Wiley's Note to Gryan Stoutmantle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:132:details:0: What I am about to tell you could cost me my life. The Defias gang is up to something big. Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.
rows.quest:132:details:1: BTake this note to Stoutmantle. It explains as much as I know on the subject.
rows.quest:132:completion:0: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. But this information is crucial. Good work.
rows.quest:135:obj:0: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:135:details:0: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
rows.quest:135:completion:0: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
rows.quest:136:obj:0: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
rows.quest:136:details:0: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave. So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues.
rows.quest:136:details:1: BFirst ye need to find me footlocker. It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of ⟦E1⟧ near the shipwreck. There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast. Find that anchor and you'll find me locker! Look in there for the next clue.
rows.quest:136:completion:0: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!
rows.quest:138:obj:0: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
rows.quest:138:details:0: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey! Now ye need to head due east. East up the bluffs, east to the road. Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road. There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
rows.quest:139:obj:0: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
rows.quest:139:details:0: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment. This one reads: Now from this here barrel, face ye North. Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs. If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.
rows.quest:139:completion:0: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
rows.quest:140:obj:0: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
rows.quest:140:details:0: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure. The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text: Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure! Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore. Once ye get to the water, keep going! Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
rows.quest:140:completion:0: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work. You force the chest open and take the booty.
rows.quest:141:obj:0: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:141:details:0: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef. VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding ⟦E3⟧ after the orcs razed it in the First War. Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete. That just might explain a thing or two.
rows.quest:141:details:1: BI have written a more detailed account for your Master in ⟦E1⟧. Take this to him at once!
rows.quest:141:completion:0: Edwin VanCleef. . .I know the name well. To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. I'll need further proof before I believe this.
rows.quest:142:obj:0: Track down the Defias Messenger in ⟦E1⟧ and bring his message to Stoutmantle.
rows.quest:142:details:0: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout. ⟦34⟧, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine. I want you to capture him. If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
rows.quest:142:completion:0: This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge. Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.
rows.quest:142:completion:1: BWe've had a stroke of luck while you were gone. We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon. He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life. I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout. Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
rows.quest:151:obj:0: Verna Furlbrow in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
rows.quest:151:details:0: Poor Old Blanchy! Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.
rows.quest:151:details:1: BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in ⟦E1⟧, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
rows.quest:151:completion:0: Thank you so much, ⟦35⟧! Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
rows.quest:152:obj:0: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E1⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:152:details:0: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of ⟦E1⟧ needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. The Murlocs are trouble though.
rows.quest:152:details:1: BKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
rows.quest:152:completion:0: Well done, ⟦36⟧. You have quite a knack for combat. Thanks to you the Coast of ⟦E1⟧ is a safer place.
rows.quest:153:obj:0: Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:153:details:0: The Defias Front is constantly shifting. I've been following their movements for quite some time now. On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.
rows.quest:153:details:1: BBring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
rows.quest:153:completion:0: Nice work, ⟦37⟧. Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
rows.quest:155:obj:0: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
rows.quest:155:details:0: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny ⟦38⟧ like you to protect me? Guess you'll have to do. Better bring some friends too.
rows.quest:155:details:1: BYou know the deal, right? You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better be close by my side. The Defias gang wants my head now. If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.
rows.quest:155:details:2: BLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
rows.quest:155:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦39⟧! VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
rows.quest:184:obj:0: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
rows.quest:184:details:0: This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within ⟦E1⟧. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:
rows.quest:184:details:1: B"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed. Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.
rows.quest:184:details:2: BThe Furlbrows won't give us trouble. Last I saw them they were on their way out of ⟦E1⟧, stuck with a broken wagon."
rows.quest:184:details:3: BYou think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
rows.quest:184:completion:0: Loads of thanks, ⟦40⟧! As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.
rows.quest:184:completion:1: BI don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
rows.quest:6181:obj:0: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.
rows.quest:6181:details:0: Although we don't get much aid from ⟦E3⟧ directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor. His name is Osric Strang. His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6181:details:1: BOur supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more. Can you take him this note?
rows.quest:6181:details:2: BThe fastest way to ⟦E3⟧ is through Thor, our gryphon master. He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6181:completion:0: You have to get this note to ⟦E3⟧? That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
rows.quest:6261:obj:0: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.
rows.quest:6261:details:0: ⟦41⟧, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for. Can you take it to him?
rows.quest:6261:details:1: BIf you've already spoken to Thor in ⟦E1⟧, then you can take a gryphon back to him. Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.
rows.quest:6261:details:2: BSpeak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can. We don't want our fighting men and women in ⟦E1⟧ to go without fresh equipment!
rows.quest:6261:completion:0: A crate for ⟦E1⟧, eh? Have you been to Westall before? If so, then it's no problem, my friend. I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
rows.quest:6281:obj:0: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6281:details:0: For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to ⟦E3⟧, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric. You won't get there faster any other way.
rows.quest:6281:details:1: BIf that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride. I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
rows.quest:6281:completion:0: Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis? I'm not surprised he needs more gear. Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land ⟦E3⟧ has all but forgotten.
rows.quest:6281:completion:1: BWell thank you, ⟦42⟧. Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
rows.quest:6285:obj:0: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.
rows.quest:6285:details:0: The gryphon master in ⟦E1⟧ is Thor. If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.
rows.quest:6285:details:1: BThat's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.
rows.quest:6285:details:2: BYou've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to ⟦E1⟧. Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
rows.quest:6285:completion:0: Great, you brought the armor! We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.
rows.quest:6285:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦43⟧. Your efforts have been a great help to us. And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
